kappa_base.note: front-to-long pass-through; episode-total mean 0.43 across 5 hiking cycles (A1)

kappa_tp_coeff.note: kappa sensitivity to 6m ACM term-premium change; n=5 episodes R2=0.58 (A1)

rho_real.note: real share of nominal surprise; 2022 realized 1.00 (A7b)

beta_spx.note: % per 100bp real surprise, 2020-26 regression (A4); spec's 5.5 failed G1 by 15x

beta_soxx.note: A4; aggressive edge with crack_soxx — do not raise both

drift_spx.note: expected total-return baseline /yr (renamed from 'earnings drift', A7f)

hyg_carry.note: dist yield /yr; FMP light endpoint has no yield history (D)

oas_theta_normal.note: 3y HY OAS median = 310 exactly; REGIME-CONDITIONAL (full-history ~430) (A7d5) — FALLBACK-ONLY in production: live oas0 anchors the normal attractor (QA finding 4)

oas_theta_stress.note: R1 (realism QA): 500 modeled a 2016-style scare; crisis OAS peaks ran 900-1900bp (2008/2011/2020). 750 + bigger jump makes the stress tail a credit event

oas_jump_entry.note: instantaneous bp on stress entry; raised 120->180 in the realism round (R1); G1 re-checked

oas_dtheta_priced.note: bp per priced hike, 2015-18 via BaaAaa proxy (A2); spec's -8 was 2x too big

oas_dtheta_surprise.note: bp per surprise 25bp; reproduces 2022 grind: 18 x 15 = 270bp (A3)

oas_taper_hikes.note: priced-hike tightening tapers to 0 after this many delivered (A2)

logistic_a.note: calibrated to spec's own targets; spec's -4.0 gave 89% vs target 35-50% (A7a)

stress_exit_monthly.note: SPEC GAP: spec defined no stress-exit prob; ~4mo mean stress duration

cs_lag_months.note: lag on CS input to stress transition (spec 4.3)

hyg_vol_w_move.note: MOVE-mapped weight in HYG vol blend; rest = realized 60d

t_nu.note: Student-t dof; t-COPULA per A6 (+29% co-crash vs Gaussian at rho=0.6)

crack_spx.note: capex-crack drift shock (log-total), phased over crack_months

stress_vol_mult.note: equity vol multiplier for stress_vol_months after entry

oas_stress_premium.note: stress attractor floor = theta_normal_path + this premium (QA finding 5: prevents stress becoming spread-tightening after a big grind)

logistic_b_cut.note: R2: dovish-surprise stress channel, per 100bp of NEGATIVE cum surprise — cuts beyond pricing historically arrive with recessions (2 of 3 deep-cut episodes ended lower; all 3 saw >=20% drawdowns)

vol_scenario_scale.note: R3: equity + normal-OAS vol scale per 100bp of |cum surprise| — big-surprise worlds are high-vol worlds (2022 realized 23% vs VIX-18 base 14.4%)

vol_scale_cap.note: cap on the scenario vol multiplier; 1.6 = 2022 realized/base ratio exactly

param_uncertainty.note: R6: draw beta/kappa per path from symmetric triangulars within their registry ranges (0 = point estimates). Gives scenario deltas honest dispersion
